correctness.rationale: For every integer \(n\ge2\) and \(1\le i<j\le n\), the conditional product update is \((1+2/k)S_i(k)S_j(k)+A S_j(k)/k\). Since \(\mathbb P(A)=1/i\) and \(\mathbb E[A S_j(k)]=k/(ij)\), induction from \(k=j\) gives \(\mathbb E[S_i(n)S_j(n)]=n^2/(ij)\). The positive diagonal variances follow from a beta-binomial Pólya urn, and telescoping parent exclusions gives strict negative leaf-indicator covariance for every \(2\le i<j<n\). Complete exact enumeration of orders two through nine was separately replayed.

value.rationale: A full zero-off-diagonal covariance structure for all specified birth labels is surprising because subtree sets overlap when ancestry holds and compete when disjoint. The statement is stronger than an isolated one-point variance or zero-covariance example, establishes strict dependence of every nonconstant pair through leaf events, and supplies a structural orthogonal decomposition of total-depth fluctuations; the exact natural statistic motivates the result.
